        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels,
            out_channels,
            kernel_size=3,
            padding=1,
            bias=False,
        )

        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
            out_channels,
            out_channels,
            kernel_size=3,
            padding=1,
            bias=False,
        )

        self.refinement_gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(out_channels))
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        return self.pool(F.silu(features + refinement, inplace=True))
